title: F5: a portable export of one correction and its complete append-only event ledger
description: Built by clozn.runs.corrections.export_correction(). Carries the correction's current stored document (clozn.correction.v1 -- content omitted if it has been deleted, exactly as the live record reads) plus every event ever recorded against it, oldest first, never filtered or summarized: drafted/confirmed/disabled/enabled/deleted/undone lifecycle events, applied/conflict_lost events tying this correction to specific runs, and verification_passed/verification_failed events (F6, clozn.runs.teaching_loop) tying it to a target-failure/child-retry run pair -- a verification_failed row is how a teaching-loop attempt that did NOT fix the target failure stays visible as evidence instead of being silently dropped; the draft it names is never promoted by that event alone. Exporting never mutates the correction or its ledger.

run_id.description: Present on 'applied' and 'conflict_lost' events (the run this correction shaped, or was surfaced-but-outvoted for) and on 'verification_passed'/'verification_failed' events (the child retry run compared against the target failure -- see `detail.target_run_id` for the other half of the pair).

detail.description: Event-specific context: an 'undo_of' event sequence number; a conflict's winner_id/rule for a conflict_lost row; a deleted_reason string for a deleted row; target_run_id/child_run_id/match_criterion/comparison for a verification_passed or verification_failed row (F6); or promoted_by/target_run_id/child_run_id/match_criterion on a 'confirmed' row that a teaching-loop promotion (rather than a hand confirm) produced.

correction.description: The clozn.correction.v1 document as currently stored.
